description: This file defines types, enums, and function prototypes for the Manufacturer Firmware Repository (MFR) interface, including error codes, serialized data handling, image management, and splash screen configuration. It appears to be a header file used for unit testing stubs related to MFR types.

methods.name: mfr_init
methods.description: Initializes the MFR library; should be called once before other functions.

methods.name: mfr_partition_init
methods.description: Initializes the MFR partition; should be called before accessing serialized data.

methods.name: mfrGetSerializedData
methods.description: Retrieves serialized read-only data from the device based on specified type.

methods.name: mfrSetSerializedData
methods.description: Sets serialized data on the device for a specified type.

methods.name: mfrWriteImage
methods.description: Writes an image into flash memory, following steps for flashing and reboot.

methods.name: mfrDeletePDRI
methods.description: Deletes the P-DRI image if present.

methods.name: mfrScrubAllBanks
methods.description: Deletes platform images from all banks.

methods.name: mfrSetBootloaderPattern
methods.description: Sets the behavior pattern of frontpanel LEDs and backlight during bootloader.

methods.name: mfrSetBlSplashScreen
methods.description: Updates the primary splash screen image with a specified file.

methods.name: mfrClearBlSplashScreen
methods.description: Resets to default splash screen image.
